description: Rupali Polyester Limited is the listed company of the Rupali Group, a Lahore-based petrochemicals business that makes the primary raw materials for Pakistan's downstream textile industry. The group describes itself as one of the largest producers of polyester filament yarn (PFY) and a leading producer of polyester staple fibre (PSF) in Pakistan, with customers in knitting, weaving, bed sheets, sportswear and water-jet weaving. It was the founding sponsor of Soneri Bank and has more recently moved into coal-fired power generation to supply its own plants.
headOffice: Rupali House, 241-242 Upper Mall Scheme, Anand Road, Lahore 54000, Pakistan
